name: Oppstar Berhad
overview: 2026年公司主要围绕与 Inventec 及 ASICAI 的谅解备忘录进行季度更新，全年未披露新的产能扩张、新业务或合约。与 ASICAI 的第二份谅解备忘录于2026年2月到期，与 Inventec 及 ASICAI 的第一份谅解备忘录截至11月无进一步重大进展。
overview_en: In 2026, the company mainly provided quarterly updates on its memorandums of understanding with Inventec and ASICAI, with no new capacity expansion, new business or contracts disclosed during the year. The second MOU with ASICAI expired in February 2026, and there was no further material development on the first MOU with Inventec and ASICAI as of November.

segments.note_en: The company provided quarterly status updates on its MOUs with Inventec and ASICAI, with no further material development during the year.
